item.title: Lamp not working, 19th August
item.description:
Lamp is not where indicated on your map, There is not a lamp post in that garden. The lamp post in question is situated on the north side of Grasmere Road and should light up the steps linking Erith Road and Grasmere Road by Fossett Lodge. With no light it is impossible to clearly see the steps and this could resulte in a bad accident. Whilst I use the steps regularly, it is not often at night when light is needed. I cannot say when the fault occurred.
